findings.text: s19 states "The wait reader in `reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py` read one failed run as the section failing" and puts that module, `recovery_vocabulary.py` and `ticker.py` in its write paths, but recovery_classification.py only formats the detail string for a stored `blocked-upstream` phase (reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py:1823) and holds no section-liveness logic at all; the phase is decided in the admission pass: `_dead_sections` (reckon/crew/admission/release.py:38-59) puts `(plan, section)` in the dead set for any live pointer whose phase is in `DEAD_RUN_PHASES = frozenset({"failed"})` (reckon/crew/admission/shared.py:188) with no check for a sibling run of the same section, `_wait_state` returns ABANDONED on that membership (reckon/crew/admission/readiness.py:1316), and `resolve_waits` returns `BLOCKED_UPSTREAM_PHASE` the moment any ref is ABANDONED (release.py:137) — so the three named write paths reach the drawing and vocabulary layers and cannot make the section's first done-when true
